intro.headline: Yanar gizo3 & ilimin crypto - koya a sarari, ba talla ba
intro.body: Web3Atlas cibiyar ilimi ce, ba aikace-aikacen ciniki ba. Bincika taswirar mahalli, bi siginonin da aka tsara, nazarin tarihin tarihin, aiwatar da tsaro na walat, buɗe ƙamus, kuma gwada kanku tare da tambayoyi - haske kan hasashe.
intro.point1: Taswirar muhalli: blockchain, DeFi, NFT, L2, wallets, DAO
intro.point2: Sigina & tarihin tarihi: kanun labarai da tarihin maɓalli
intro.point4: Kalmomi & Tambayoyi: bayyanannun kalmomin da zaku iya buɗewa da aiwatarwa
